_comment: Descripción de cada efecto para ElevenLabs Text to Sound Effects. Cambiar el texto y volver a generar con `npm run sfx -- <id>`.

whoosh.text: Short soft airy whoosh, smooth upward swipe transition, clean modern app promo, no reverb tail

tap.text: Single soft UI tap on a phone screen, subtle muted click, clean and dry

pop.text: Small light bubbly pop, friendly UI tag appearing, short and soft

stamp.text: Rubber stamp pressed firmly on paper, short woody thud with a light paper slap, dry

rise.text: Gentle soft paper slide and rise, light rustle of tropical leaves, warm and short

notification.text: Warm pleasant two-note phone notification chime, wooden marimba, short

reward.text: Bright cheerful reward sparkle, small coins and soft marimba arpeggio, celebratory but subtle

logo.text: Warm short logo sting, soft marimba and acoustic guitar strum with a gentle tropical bird chirp, Colombian coffee brand
